**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

- **Searched locations:** §2 LICENSE (grant, scope, term, ownership), §8 Client covenants and warranties, §1 definitions, recitals, §5/§6 compensation, §7 spamming, §10 confidentiality, and §§12–30 (including term, termination, assignment). Targeted searches for "compete/competing/competitor", "Non-Competition", "exclusive", "field of use", "restrict", "shall not develop", "Client shall not".
- **Result:** No non-compete or field-of-use restraint binds Client. §2(a) grants only a **non-exclusive** licence and expressly states Client "is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret" for similar software and services — the preferred element is met verbatim.
- **Boundary calls made:** (i) the §3(i) credit-report sourcing sentence bites only when Client voluntarily seeks underwriting approval through the Interface and is coupled with express freedom to use alternatives, so it is a conditional sourcing term, not exclusivity; (ii) the "Non-Competition Agreement" cited in §8(d) operates as a **limitation on TrueLink's** Credit Data licence — it protects us, so it is not flagged; (iii) the IP non-infringement and confidentiality provisos in §2(a) are ordinary carve-outs, not competitive restraints.
- **No redline proposed**, consistent with the instruction not to flag terms that benefit our party.
